notes.title: 1.5.0a "2 Player Co-op Update"

It's here finally! After heaps of work, I was able to pull off the new 2 Player Co-op for those who requested it! This update has changed the base game in some sections. multiplayer code has been changed to accommodate for the new 2 Player mode. I tested everything I could on my own so issues may arise that I was not able to find on my own.

Let's not keep you waiting! 

Fixes
-Doors and meshes now have the correct collisions.
-Button code not working now will listen to the host and work.
-Random code triggering music in cutscenes now will trigger correctly.
-Random camera shake triggering in cutscenes now will not happen.

Changes

-Main Menu has been updated to accommodate the Multiplayer Changes.
-Control schemes have been updated in the UI.
-Sounds have been adjusted to better fit cutscenes.
-Master Override has been updated with brighter VFX.

Additions

-New Archaeologist Class (For 2 Player Co-op)
-New Navigator Class (For 2 Player Co-op)

Hope you all enjoy this new Update! 
-R

notes.title: Dev Diary #10
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles[/h1]
[h3]Dev Diary #10[/h3]

Welcome to the 10th Instalment of the Dev Diary Series! Its been a long Silence over the Holiday break! In that time the game has had the chance to go on sale and a few of you have been enjoying your selfs puzzling it out with friends or enjoying the puzzles on their own! Either way it has been so nice to watch you all. :)

Before we begin I wanted to apologise for the delay for the Dev Diary. In the December time I was unfortunate and caught covid-19, and to top that my Current system I use to develop games was having "Issues". Im on top of it now and recovering fully from the Illness! Enough about me time to get onto the Dev Diary!


[h2]The News[/h2]

We are getting back on track. We are through the holiday period of time and I'\m returning to work now. This means the develop on Levi Chronicles is back on track.

This will also put me back on the Development Schedule I have had planned out. This may be a few weeks behind with the covid-19 Situation but still, on track for a new Update. This will be covered more now in the next part.


[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]

In December I had a update planned and was on track for release in late December. Things changed when I picked up the virus and ended up Pushing it back. The Update contains some new visual and server code improvements plus some extra new secrets... :) I will be releasing this update within the next few weeks.

Aside from the updates being made to Chapter 1 work has been powering on in-engine to create the Chapter 2 & Commissions Experience smoother then its predecessor Chapter 1. This aranges from Movement systems to Multiplayer Code cleaning to make sure the player experience is much smoother.

There has been massive Visual upgrades in the development of Commissions. It has been hard to work and try to adapt to the new Desert Theme, but progress is finally looking to be in the green now. Special work has been put into dust storms with Unreals inbuilt volumetric's. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/8d2b8914f0ce33c3c4177d4717fbae48eb909068.png[/img]
Day Light Test
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/efe80c9d927561385acf3064db43722f70030e6c.png[/img]
Sun Set Test
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/d092560894b050ced51fee912cec5f0b1cf32902.png[/img]
Night Light Test (With added lights in the sand)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/d9f55700890afa7acb53ce4753768cda2825c402.png[/img]
Final Visual Test

Hope you all enjoyed the visuals. Another aspect that is taking shape is the Skill Sets. Currently the Linguist skill sets are fully complete. Explorer Skill Sets are next to be created...

Music is also another major side being developed currently. I am working hard to learn and create Loop sound tracks. One of the funnest sides of making games is the music for me! :)

Its time to move on to our pipeline section!


[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]

Looking at my Timeline its stretching over a years of development for the next chapter! Planning for a release of Chapter 2 around the End of the year roughly. If Im able to keep on track with my schedule. 

Commissions are planned for a earlier release then Chapter 2 as that will be my testing ground for some features...

Not really much I can cover in this Section though so time to finish up!


[h2]The Community... See the Future[/h2]

To finish off I want to give a big thanks for those buying and supporting the Project! Seeing that I feel so happy that people are enjoying the game! A big thanks to you all!

Thanks for coming along to this Dev Diary and cant wait to see you in the next Dev Diary!

-R

notes.title: Dev Diary #9
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles[/h1]
[h3]Dev Diary #9[/h3]

Hello! Welcome back, to the Ninth instalment of the Dev Diary Series! It has been a great Month and a bit! I have been able to achieve a lot more with the games development and I cant wait to show you what progress I have made.

Lets get a move along shall we?


[h2]The Plan[/h2]

To begin I want to tell you some of my plans for Levi Chronicles & Atmosphere Studio. Over the next coming weeks work on a Website will be created for Atmosphere Studio. This will help streamline information on the game and its development much better and in a more universal location for everyone to access. 

The Website will also have other uses in the future, but as for now it will be a basic start. Lets move onto The Inner Engine section of the Dev Diary!


[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]

Work on Chapter 2, Commissions and Chapter 1 has been the Major Focus of the last month.

[h3]Chapter 1 - The Beginning[/h3]
To start us off we will go through the changes to Chapter 1. Majority of changes to Chapter 1 have been Fixes to Bugs people have experience. Some of the multiplayer code has been rewritten to help those who were having high ping while playing. 

Chapter 1 has also had some Lighting Changes for the Multiplayer and Single-player to help replicate the same lighting across the Chapters. The Adjustments were minor but make a big difference.

Another few changes that were added was a new Checkpoint to start at called "Fast Start" for those friends who want to Skip the tutorial and get straight into the game.

I have a few Images here to show you the current changes to Chapter 1 Visually. Hope you enjoy! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/82897aabcb9c779e2a369bcca4c0f931bf68423c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/de3e985c7727d69bffe3acac26456b9717845d31.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/82ebeffd8f47bd5e8f30477274d774930c02eb15.png[/img]

[h3]Commissions[/h3]
The work on Commissions is in full swing! Work on characters models and Character Customisation is in development currently as well as character animations and movement systems. This Process requires a lot of fine tuning.

The new Characters I'm creating for commissions are more complicated then the previous models so it has taken me A LOT more time then expected. This has slowed down the work on Commission Skill sets.

Here is a couple of Sample images of the work being done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/e64d5dac20ead66799edfbe7d6e397d7b6bbebf2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/50b42384252b32c9ba9879bf7a7fca3246fea739.png[/img]

[h3]Chapter 2 - The Hunt[/h3]
The Work on chapter 2 is very steady. The Music Department is currently the most active but the story and script work is most required and has been getting work every now and then...

For now ill keep this side of the Dev Diary a little secretive... ;)


[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]

Im going to sum up this part of the Dev Diary to keep it simple. 
It will be done when its done. But in all seriousness. With my current work and progress on the game is going way slower then expected... I haven't had much free time to be able to catch up on the work. I promise though im trying my best and I will have this in your hands as soon as I can! :)

Lets move onto the more Spicier part of this Dev Diary!


[h2]The Community... See the Future[/h2]

Through the month, the community has been very active! I have Loved watching all of you play the game and enjoy the experience! Its so much fun when you and your friends try to solve puzzles together. 

If anyone of you would like to view some of the streams Ill be leaving them here for you to check out!

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1185366246]Voltrakkon Twitch Stream Levi Chronicles[/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1195377107]beeboy148 Twitch Stream Levi Chronicles[/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1196201376]Shady_Love Twitch Stream Levi Chronicles[/url]

Though the game has had it bugs it certainly is fun to watch! Especially when the team goes a little crazy! But a suggestion is to "Paint it" to help solve it ;)

Best community content I've seen haha!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/432aa067b9f0abff038a547cf0998f8e10b05879.png[/img]

I have really loved watching these streams! and I hope to see more!!!! I shall call it there. Thanks for coming along for this Dev Diary. I hope you all enjoy and I cant wait to give you more! 

-R

notes.title: Dev Diary #8
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles[/h1]
[h3]Dev Diary #8[/h3]

Hello! Welcome to the Eight instalment of the Dev Diary Series! I have been quiet the past few weeks with my work I do, It has taken up a big chunk of time. It hasn't stopped me from working on the game. I have been able to plan out a lot more!

Lets not waist time! Ill show the latest work I have been up too...


[h2]The Vision[/h2]

I wont spend too much time on this part. The Latest I want to show you is my Current plan of showing progress on the games Development! 

I use a tool called Trello that helps me keep track of where I am on things... I have decided to use it again to help organise the work I do, so when I come back from a long break I can easily see where I left off!

You will also be allowed to view this [url=https://trello.com/b/hLZJhqOi]Here.[/url]

Lets move on!


[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]

Nothing too much to talk about in the Inner Engine this round. A lot of the work i have been focusing on is writing and Story related. Though when I need a break from writing I work on some of the Art for the next Chapter of the game, Currently the work has been focused on this lovely creation I have made that I called "Peep Creep".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/e480ec0497005699665c651ff19887c2678510a9.png[/img]

I am slowly trying to increase my skills in the character art side of things so I can make good, compelling Stories. Peep Creep is the first iteration of my characters for the Commissions Gamemode.

Im also using this time to give a proper crack at face rigging. Chapter 2 will require this in a few areas as you and Emilia Coleman will need to talk to the Locals in the new chapter of the Story.

Not too much else has happened in the Engine side of things. I have Completed the basic movement for the Characters and Refined it much more to the old Movement system. Popular demand lead to me adding crouching and a fun little mechanic... 

Sliding! When your running in those tough situations you can always trust your handy slide mechanic to get out of trouble!! It has been a lot of fun making this and i cant wait to get it out too you!

The other things being tested are the new Modular Puzzles system, just experimenting with that, managed to create some fun little arenas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/b36568187dfcd017c087a70d51e1d8046586a646.png[/img]

A little update on some old progress made is the Art side of Chapter 2. Working on some new methods to make Sand Dunes and managed to get these pretty decent looking ones. here is a sneak peak

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/fdcecff7bf8b516b0fb6d4a7183c44d29d42dd70.png[/img]

That's all I can show for now! Ill keep you all updated in my next Dev Diary with the Engine Progress! Lets move on!


[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]

The Progress on Chapter 2 and Commissions is going steady, Haven't ran into to many issues yet. I don't have Release dates ideas yet for Chapter 2 or Commissions. It will be a slow and Steady project for now.

Another thing I will put out there is I have plans to release a Demo of Commissions before its released. It will act like a Beta test in a sense. I want to get peoples thoughts and opinions of it to make it a fun game! So keep a keen eye for that. 

Last thing I will mention is Voice Casting roles for Chapter 2 and Commissions are in the pipeline! I am currently planning out all the necessary details for it but soon on the [url=https://discord.gg/MxuKbzrFsp]Discord Server[/url] I will be hosting auditions for the new roles of Chapter 2 and Commissions. It will be completely voluntary and wont have any limits. So keep a look out for more information on that too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/81846e6351333fc7e14e488edf629f8fca5569c7.png[/img]


[h2]The Community... See the Future[/h2]

To Finish off this Dev Diary I would like to say to the community thank you for the support so far! I really love seeing it. I cant wait to start working with you guys again on Testing for bugs, Impression Testing and just in general seeing you play! Makes me happy to see that :)

Thanks for coming along to this Dev Diary!  Stay Tuned for the next one!

notes.title: Dev Diary #7
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles[/h1]
[h3]Dev Diary #7[/h3]

Welcome to the seventh instalment of the Dev Diary Series! Its been exciting behind the scenes, working really hard on the start of the next phase of Levi Chronicles! 

Lets not waist time and let me tell you about The Vision!


[h2]The Vision[/h2]
So once I had Levi Chronicles Chapter 1 finished, it has given me time to step back and look over what has been accomplished. Making the game was a lot of fun. but looking at the game I can see a concept that hasn't been explored. 

So the last couple of weeks I have been back at the drawing board to go over some ideas of where I will take the game. Of course I will be continuing the main story, that will be my primary focus, but a opportunity has appeared for the game, the games scale can be much larger then just a story adventure game.

Here is the current Vision for the game! 

[h3]Commissions[/h3]
Commissions will not follow the main story directly but will follow in the same world. The Objective of Commissions is for you or you and your partner to locate a "Artifact" within the play area you are given. These will be surrounded by a rich environment to explore and puzzles to solve.

The Commissions will follow along the same lines as how chapter 1 went. You will have to Explore Ruins and Temples to find your Artifact. The Main part of these Temples will be the puzzles. I want to make sure I make a rich set of puzzles that can be customised from a developers view point to make the creation process quicker!

Story wise, Commissions will be handed out by 2 People.
- A.R.C (Agency of Research & Classification)
- Emilia Coleman 

The idea behind having 2 vendors for Commissions is to change the objective of the Commission. Emilia will want you to find out more about the culture that made the ruins to help in the hunt for Levi, Somewhat like a free roam mode, but the A.R.C are only after the Artifacts that are found at these Temples, Ruins and Locations for research into the past.

Along the lines of story! There will also be 2 groups of treasure hunters joining the race in the Commissions!
- The Relic (The Relic of the Gods)
- United Coalition of Hunters

The Enemy groups will play a part in your Commissions. They will be trying to find the Artifacts first to follow in there own agenda. "The Relic" are group that are focused on restoring ancient powers back to humanity(Tomb raider vibe XD). While one the other hand the "United Coalition of Hunters" are treasure hunters only after Fame and Money. You will have to be careful around them to not get caught while completing your objective!

Moving on. Commissions will also introduce the new Class system that will apply for Commissions only. You will be given a set of skills to choose from to create your own class to work with your play style!

The Skill sets will rely on the first 4 classes in the first chapter and a new one in the concept phase! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/8d1dd56387f879d54d80bc693cd18efece6ff45c.png[/img]
-[b]Explorer Skill[/b] (Explorers Skill can help the player track down footprints or old paths, as well as a flare for light and a beacon to set way-points that everyone on your team can see.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/86e506490e284c859e91faa3e5189b270cfbf998.png[/img]
-[b]Detector Skill[/b] (Detectors Skill will range from classic Scanning ability, but with a twist you will need to calibrate the scanner to locate different objects for different use.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/ed0ba8f4c8d112471c013f82b658681cca675aed.png[/img]
-[b]Extractor Skill[/b] (Extractor Skill will involve a few new tools in his arsenal from the Normal large explovise to a weak small explosive to help uncover smaller objects or Murals that are more fragile to extract, Another skill will be digging to locate Artifacts that are underground.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/e1294ef177703f8fcb2b600319d619f1154e6794.png[/img]
-[b]Linguist Skill[/b] (Linguist will be getting the Skill he deserves now with his ability to Translate ruins! but this will all depends on his reading level. finding more objects to translate will help clear up the language barrier to uncover old clues and riddles.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/2e9c4b16a1a15064eb5fa37a7cb2e05a171e971b.png[/img]
-[b]Geologist Skill[/b] (Geologist Skill will be the new class added to the game in Commissions! The skill is in early concept but some feedback on the game, someone mentioned a map man should be introduced to help locate where you are, This will be 1 of the Skills of the Geologist. Geologist Skill will also have the ability to tell how old structures are to determine if the path you are on is the correct one and not left by greedy treasure hunters who want to put you off there scent!)

Skill Classes are still to be expended on and is not final, so feedback is also nice :). Now that we have explored the Skill Classes. I want to talk to you about the timeline for this. I cant be too specific as all this is all in early concept currently, but It is going to take a bit of time. The Reason I will be doing Commissions is to get people playing more then just a story. I want people to have fun with creating there own stories in the Levi Chronicles World! This was what I had in mind originally when I first started making games.

I don't want to rush this all out too. This was all a passion project after all. Since I'm a Dev working on this alone it will take some time. But I feel if I Shared the idea now I could get people keen for whats to come. I'm going to start Opening up the Games Development visually to ALL who are keen to see this come!

Ill make sure I host more Alpha Sessions for this game and ill Open up the testing to all of you! I want this to work and I think ill have a lot of fun working with you all! But now I will move on to the next Vision!

Before we move on I would also like to note Commissions will most likely be a 1 or 2 Player Gamemode. Unsure about 4 yet...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/81846e6351333fc7e14e488edf629f8fca5569c7.png[/img]
[h3]Levi Chronicles Chapter 2[/h3]
[h3]The Hunt[/h3]
This will be the Second instalment of the Main Story for Levi Chronicles! I wont reveal much on this with the story elements, but I will give you this.

Story is still in the late writing Phase. It is a little complicated to write because what ever I change here has big effects on the Last Chapter of the Story. I have to make sure everything is perfect here now so when it comes to the final Chapter, Everything will be in place for a Perfect Finale!

Also Chapter 2 is Desert Themed!!!!!
Check out the progress on the [url=https://twitter.com/AtmosphereStud1/status/1430419998997041157?s=20]Main Theme of Chapter 2 Here!!![/url]
Its time to move on to the Dev Diary Essentials!

[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]
Welcome to the Inner Engine! Its been a little bit busy with the work inside the engine. Most of the work done has been clean ups and multiplayer fixes! There was a Full Screen Issue that has bugged the community but I have put a Fix in place for that too.

Chapter 2 wise I have been working on the new characters code for the second chapter. I am completely rewriting the code for the Characters has the old one were... messy XD. Its going much faster though with the knowledge I have now. 

I did a full engine clean-out for the major code I have stored. It has made my work flow smoother and better. Hopefully will get the new content to you guys sooner too! Lets move on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/092b3643727c921da788fb78c0a8f5c2273cd3d5.png[/img]
[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]
Not Really too much I can say on this part. I have a lot of work cut out for me.

With Commissions being on the bored too it will prolly slow the work alittle, but the rewards of doing that will increase the speed of all the story chapters by 10 fold. notes.title: Dev Diary #6
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles[/h1]
[h3]Dev Diary #6[/h3]

Welcome to the next instalment of the Dev Diary Series for Levi Chronicles! Its been a while since launch now, we had a bit of a rough start too! but that has been mostly patched now. Before we get into the Dev diary I would like to thank everyone for all the Help and Support! I love seeing you play the game and the laughs people have had together, So Thank you Everyone!!!

Lets begin the Dev Diary and see what we have planned for you all!

[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]
So since launch I have been slowly refining the Inner code of the game to be more multiplayer friendly and compatible. Completely rewrote the puzzle code in Multiplayer! it was a very intense few days to try and get it all working again for people. Though this still isn't fixed to all people. I have received a few messages from people with issues still not gone. I am working on investigating these issues still. You have not been forgotten! I will over the next few days be conducting some surveys to find out PC specs and find out the different issues everyone is facing.

Exciting things have been started inside the Engine development! with the Chapter 1 story completed, work on Chapter 2 has begun! there are no planned release dates for this chapter of the story, but I can tell you that the Story boarding is completed and all written up. Work on the art-style has begun!

To finish off this part of the Dev Diary I would like to mention that I am off development for the next week to fill in at my other job so not much will be done over the week. After that I will have a month of free time to work on Game development so ill be holding off on the Dev Diary's a little bit.

Lets move onto "The Pipeline"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/81846e6351333fc7e14e488edf629f8fca5569c7.png[/img]

[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]

With the start of the work on Chapter 2, People might be wondering where 2 Player Coop might be. Well I would like to say that this feature is being considered still, but it may not be for the Main Story though... 

It's a little hard to explain my thinking process but I am also considering a new Gamemode to the game called "Side Missions". Due to how hard it is to code multiplayer it makes it hard for me make a game 4 player, to 2 player and to single-player. I struggle to translate the base story over to these different states.  The Goal of "Side Missions" is to make a 4, 2 Player Coop and single-player compatible without translation needed when creating it. So it can be completely up to design to make the game good.

Side Missions will also add a bit of replay-ability to the game. Its still in concepting phase but i will share this bit of knowledge. It will possibly have Skill Trees to help add some variety to the game when playing!

Before i finish this part I would like to add that this is all early concept and nothing is set in stone yet! But I am keen to give this my best shot and I'm excited to see what I can make out of this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/53647d72af82e7da1090f5506edba9daa520a7e0.png[/img]

[h2]The Community... See the Future[/h2]

I have been really enjoying watching the community play the game! and people seem to be enjoying to the story as well!

There also has been issues the community has been running into. Some not even able to launch the game... Little saddening but ill be working hard on fixing these issues!

I'm excited to see what people do in the game and cant wait to see more content! 

For those who want to talk to the Levi Chronicles Community I recommend joining the [url=https://discord.gg/5b9Mxga6Wf]Discord[/url]. I love to talk to people and hear feedback on the game. some people have even suggested new game-play and well. Lets just say I'm doing more then just considering it!

Also check out the [url=https://twitter.com/AtmosphereStud1]Twitter[/url] for small updates on the development of the game! Hope you enjoyed!

Can't wait to get Chapter 2 into full swing development! and can't wait for the next Dev Diary! Keep an Keen eye out for that :)

-R

notes.title: Release Multiplayer Issues...
notes.notes:
[h1]Release and the Wreckage[/h1]
Hello all! I has already been a rough launch! I am SOOO sorry about that! I wish these issues were known of sooner but it came to light only recently. 

To sum up the current issues, Multiplayer is not working due to desyncing. The caused of this I believe is the pipeline of network code sent from the servers to the clients and clients to the server is being over run with non-essential code. 

This causes MAJOR desyncing while playing the game, it breaks the game in ways i didn't expect, parts i thought were flawless now have issues. To counter this over the next week I will be digging into the code of the game and attempt to rewrite the multiplayer side of things to fix this error. 

It will not be a simple task and may take some time to complete. I really didn't want to see it go like this, again, I apologise. As the only dev on the game it make it a little hard to do some task and it does take more time then usual. I will give you my plan.

Over the next week i will be giving you small patches to trouble shoot the errors to see if things i change help, or break the game more. These patches will only apply in Multiplayer. The Singleplayer currently is in a good state. 

Once the week is over and I've determined what might need change. The week after that I will begin the major rewriting. That process will take as long as it needs. until i can fix the Desync issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/5a4567eb95065f4ab46b6ac2c23cad6bb208887a.png[/img]

[h2]The Aftermath[/h2]
It was a rougher launch then expected, I am new too all this and I want to make it right! If you feel you didn't get the product you wanted, refund if needed. but come back soon as I will, and I promise I will get this issue solved! Its what we all want!

Keep a keen eye out for announcements and patches! I hope to see more people join along and feel free to try the singleplayer! it follows the same story you follow in the multiplayer so you wont miss out!

If you also want to talk to me personally come and join the [url=https://discord.gg/Ge5vGmyPdz]Discord![/url] I am always happy to talk and meet new people, and I love to hear peoples suggestions on what i can do to improve! :)

I will call it a night for now. I will be back to work soon! I hope I didn't ruin to many peoples days today! :(

Thanks for staying along and we will get through it soon
-R

notes.title: Dev Diary #4
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles Chapter 1[/h1]
[h3]Dev Diary #4[/h3]

Welcome to the Fourth instalment of the Dev Diary Series! We will be viewing over some sad news but also we will be getting our first look into the Levi Chronicles Story! First we will begin with the Inner Engine!

[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]
Since it's been a while since the last Dev Diary there is a lot of stuff to cover. Lets start off with the Development side of things!

The Latest I have been working on involved Cinematic's and cut-scenes. Since I'm not a professional director/developer I lack skill in these areas, so i have been putting a lot of effort into trying to learn how cinematic are made and whats the best methods to execute certain styles. With this has lead me to working on other-side of development too.

Audio. It's not my strong suit and I tend to avoid it. I struggle making good sounding audio. I was recently introduced to a new developing tool for audio production. much more official and more capable of doing what I need it to do. It's been a slow learning curve to figure it out, but it has given some amazing results!

While on the subject of audio. I have been working on the OST for the game too. attempting to figure out where music needs change or fixing. It has been a lot of fun actually. I decided to go back to my first drafts of the melody I will be using for each chapter. While going over them I was able to make them sound much nicer and more official with my new Music Skills.

Music is probably the fun side of audio creation for me! 

To briefly cover the rest I had been working on multiplayer sessions and the Lobby systems. it has lead to me fixing a few issues with the UI and multiplayer as well. 

There was 1 more major thing i had been working on and that was Players and debuffing. Instead if killing the player when they are hit by a explosion, they will instead be debuffed for a period of time. Much more player friendly and will make game-play much easier and more fluid.

It is time to move!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/8cd73c8b21c31e18d00bc49a9c71fede6e417ab2.png[/img]

[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]
Firstly i would like to apologise first of all, Some of you are expecting a release by the end of this month, but due to my poor predicting skills i will be missing the deadline... 

It is my fault and I would like to say sorry. I am new to this all and my deadlines are running off experience of a baby! I feel bad for doing this...

But...

To make up for that i have a rough estimate of a release date. While talking to Valve and after careful discussion. Release is aimed for Mid June, If the game does not pass the check up from Valve by then, I will have to push the release to Mid July. I really don't want to release July so the aim is 100% focused on June!

And in other news! There is a Reveal Trailer for Levi Chronicles out now! You can finally see what the game has install for all of you!
[previewyoutube=J3u5eHSub_c;full][/previewyoutube]
Now that we have had a look into what the game has install! lets move on to our last part of the Dev Diary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/c403ed50f5c409c1252896a0e154436e1d72361d.png[/img]

[h2]The Community... See the Future[/h2]

With the game being delayed that also means the Beta Testing is delayed! Some people have been waiting for literal years for the beta test and i know me pushing it back is going to feel like forever! So Sorry about it!

One thing i would like to request is some feedback on my community skills! I don't know how the community is going because i don't see the full community! If you see this game and you are interested in joining and helping along, join my [url=https://discord.gg/MxuKbzrFsp]Discord[/url]! I tried to watch there the most to see what people think of my work. and it helps me to talk to people who want to see what this game is!

Thank you for joining along this Dev Diary!
See you around -R

notes.title: Dev Diary #3
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles Chapter 1[/h1]
[h3]Dev Diary #3[/h3]

Welcome to the Third Dev Diary! Sorry for being so quiet past couple of weeks! I have been busy with a couple of things, but it has not stopped me working very hard on Levi Chronicles and trying to finish Chapter one!

[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]
Lets start off with seeing the latest in development side of things! 

Lately i have been working on optimisation for Levi Chronicles to help those with lower end PC's. I have made a huge amount of progress in removing a lot of unnecessary effects and elements that cause lag and reduce them.

I've also been attempting to refine the ending cut-scene. A few elements that are missing are Music and 2 game-play features. This process wont take long to complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/d9abc57d757d563be36c5472ed22bce3c23ae2de.png[/img]

[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]
The First thing i would like to cover is a release date...

I am happy to announce that Levi Chronicles is aiming to be in Early Access on...

[h3]31st of May[/h3]

There we have it everyone! Now i will say now this is not all set in stone! How this is going to work is a little bit complicated behind the scenes. Here is a rundown of how this will all happen.

[h3]Wave 1 First Impression Testing[/h3]
This will begin from the 26th of April and ends 2nd of May.
I have selected people to participate in these tests to find out what the first impressions are and what can be changed/fixed.

[h3]Wave 2 First Impression Testing[/h3]
This will begin on the 3rd of May and ends 9th of May.
After Wave 1 I will go through the game is fix up anything that might be lacking or needs changes before Wave 2. In Wave 2 it will be more like a second impression test for those who participated in Wave 1. I will also select a couple of more Testers to join in Wave 2 to still get what i need in a first Impression test.

[h3]Wave 1 Beta[/h3]
This will begin on the 10th of May and ends 16th of May.
After both waves of First Impression testing are complete i will move into Beta. The Beta Process will run in groups of 4. Testing will be selective. invited will be sent out personally to people.

[h3]Wave 2 Beta[/h3]
This will begin on the 17th of May and ends 23rd of May.
This sill be the last week of Beta testing ill have. If all goes smoothly and there are minimal problems. Release will stay on course!

Alright! That covers the Process over the nest few weeks.
One thing I want to cover that is very important so I don’t let some people down is the option for single player. The game hasn’t changed. Single player will be in the game, But I will most likely be after release. The single player story mode will follow the same story in the multiplayer mode. But with the development process of making a multiplayer game single player is a little bit harder then I thought. But I will have that released as soon as I can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/e06bf4a2a4a78b1c45e2b9e0ec02d467f5e041b3.png[/img]

[h2]The Community... See the Future[/h2]
Alright well i just wanted to say Thank you! To all the community and those who have been supporting me along the way of making this game! Its been a heck of a ride, and I have enjoyed most of it. The only reason i have kept going this long is the amount of support I have been getting! It really makes me happy to see people interested in the title! it was a passion project at first. How much it had changed since then!

The Community has been waiting for 2 Years straight to see this pull through and we are on the final steps. 

Before i sign off i wanted to mention for those who might be interested in participating in the Beta Phase, please feel free to join [url=https://discord.gg/MxuKbzrFsp]Discord[/url] and message me about it and ill put you into the list for Beta Testing Groups. Those who get invited will be messaged directly and will need to follow the instructions provided.

Thanks you -R

If you wish to you can join my [url=https://discord.gg/aBkrdA89ec]Discord[/url] if you would like to get in touch or would like to watch the development up close!

[h2]The Inner Engine[/h2]
Well working on this game has been a long and educational process! For my first project that is being released i'm real happy to share it with you!

Its been a gritty job though. As a solo Dev it has been hard to try and work on all sides of the project! I'm sure some people will know the feeling! Working with the Engine, Asset Creation, Audio Design, Story Boarding and now Community! i have found it a bit of a challenge to learn. 

Learning Networking in Levi Chronicles has been a Process as well! I have never had any experience in networking prior to starting this project! I have gotten help from many people/sources over the entirety of the project! and I am still learning new Networking code this day! I'm real happy with where I have gotten the project so far! makes me real happy to see what I've accomplished so far and plan to improve in future too!

I have been Finishing some Networking testing lately and I am getting all the story Element in to finalise it all! I have had the best Team of Alpha Testers and i am Excited to say I will be moving into Beta very soon! For Those who want to look into joining the Beta Please join the [url=https://discord.gg/aBkrdA89ec]Discord[/url] to keep up to date and be first dibs into the betas!

[h2]The Pipeline[/h2]
Currently I have a Date in mind I want to attempt to release the game by but with the current issues I may have to push it back a month or 2. I Don't want to get your hopes up only for you to be disappointed with my failed deadline!

I do want to apologise for that, I know some of you are looking for a date of release but i just want to make sure its not a unplayable game on release, I want everyone to enjoy the story, on Single and Multiplayer!

I will Update you all as soon as i can when I have a release date!

A reveal trailer is still in the works and will be out soon! I'm hoping I will have it out by the next Dev Diary! and talking about the next Dev Diary, I am planning to make this Dev Diary a Fortnightly announcement. The Diaries will depend on if I have content to update you all on!

notes.title: Meet The Dev Conclusion
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666553/2fae01e2cb9bc4ecd519fe4b822027a4c6691091.png[/img]
[h1]Time to Sum Up "Meet the Dev"[/h1]
We had Complications with Steam in the end and not many were able to join! Instead of using steam we used discord to continue the Event! 

All went well and we had a Variety of Questions!

Here is a couple of questions that were answered!


[h3]1. Have you gotten this far with any other games you've developed and decided to trash them?[/h3]

No Most my Other Projects haven't ever really made it off the "Concept Phase" making this Product the First Completed one!



[h3]2. What makes this game different from other puzzle adventure games likes the series " we were here " (ive never played them just read about them)[/h3]

I have Played the We were here Series and Man they are good games! With Levi Chronicles I have definitely taken inspiration from the "We were here" games! I do have Puzzles to solve, but Levi Chronicles would honestly be more closer to a Tomb raider game as you will uncover the story of Levi and why he is missing. The Story is very In-depth and I hope everyone enjoys it. 

Another thing that will separate the two games is the Class System. You and your friends will have to use your "Class"(Character) to help each other get through the Temples and Puzzles!



[h3]3. What was your inspiration for this game?[/h3]

Honestly It's a mix of things, I generally love to make stories and man this one got Pretty Big! I was determined to make a Story game that a group of friends can experience!



[h3]4. I heard this will be a saga, when should we hear news about the next episode?[/h3]

You will be happy to know that the next Episode is already planned out! I will not be disclosing any information on that until after the Release of the First Episode.



[h3]5. Will there be easter eggs in this game?[/h3]

It isn't a game without them!



[h3]6. What is the most stressful thing about making a game?[/h3]

Deadlines...



[h3]7. Any advice on making a game?[/h3]

Don't stop trying, no matter how much you cry!



[h3]8. How much is the game?[/h3]

Roughly 8$ AU



[h3]9. Planning on adding any special editions to the game?[/h3]

Physical Copy's of the game are in the process currently.



[h3]10. Ever planning on releasing footage of your earlier games? like a little dev doco?[/h3]

Dev Dairy will be making a appearance soon! So keep a eye out for those!



[h3]11. Console release?[/h3]

Hmm, Possibly? Unconfirmed...



[h3]12. Will the next game in the series (saga) be any bit different from this game?[/h3]

Yes, but i will not Disclose any information at this time!


[h1]To Conclude![/h1]
Had a blast and hope to see more people in our next Event!

notes.title: Levi Chronicles Chapter 1 Reveal
notes.notes:
[h1]Levi Chronicles, What is it?[/h1]

Most of you have been watching my game and waiting for information on what this game is about and if it will be fun! Well I'm finally happy to be handing out the first bit of info to you all!

[h2]Levi Chronicles Chapter I[/h2]
[h2]The Beginning[/h2]

The first game I will be releasing is called "Levi Chronicles Chapter I, The Beginning''.
Its the first in a Saga of stories you will uncover while you play the games. I have planned to release these stories in Chapters and there are more planned in the future! 

The Game in its current state it is a Multiplayer Story game. You and 3 friends will be tasked to traverse these environments and follow the story of Levi. You will solve puzzles, survive dangers and discover lost civilisations! 

Players will play together using 4 separate roles. They are named 
-Explorer
-Detector
-Extractor
-Linguist
Each role will have there own unique ability's that will help everyone on there journey through the story. Working together will play a Key part in Levi Chronicles, but if you don't have a group of friends to play with, don't worry! Players will be able to join Public Crews which will make getting together much easier for a solo player!

Players will also have a in-game voice chat that will give them the ability to talk to there Crew freely! 

[h1]The Plans for the Future?[/h1]

I plan to add a Single Player Story mode that will follow the same story of Levi Chronicles but you will complete it solo. This is planned for a release in the future of the games Development.

I have Concepts in the works too for a "Side Missions" feature! players will be able to explore the world and discover ruins relating to the Levi Saga. Though ill point out it is a concept at the moment! It could be scrapped! 

After the release of Chapter I, I plan for the second instalment of the saga which will be entitled!
Chapter II. what a surprised! haha. the Chapter name will be announced in a future date. 

[h1]My plans for the Community[/h1]

I Plan to be active with the community in the near future. I will be trying to post more community updates so everyone can stay up to date. 

A little surprise for everyone is there will be a coming up community update for you all with a reveal trailer for Levi Chronicles Chapter I! 

[h1]What Now???[/h1] 
As a Lone Developer on this Project I would like to thank those people who have supported and help me on this project and I feel Excited to announce this Title to the Public! 

In the meantime Enjoy my second Sneak peak into Levi Chronicles Chapter I![previewyoutube=rnOQU1gWPJY;full][/previewyoutube]

I can't wait to give this game to you all and I hope enjoy it as much as it was to make it!!!
-R

notes.title: Levi Chronicles Chapter 1
notes.notes:
[h1]Day 45[/h1]

It's not well... I haven't been able to decipher any of these letters. I don't even know if these are letters. only thing I can see is the name, Eldorat. Why is the God of foundation mentioned in a totally different location!

I am grinding my head into a cheese grater a this point, and its not help that I'm constantly under attack by paparazzi, asking me if I'm going insane. Can't they just leave me alone. I am following my dads work! His LIFE WORK!

It hurts my Heart to see all this hate.
I need to find this soon, I know it will change everything!

[h1]What is this???[/h1]

Hello!
Im the developer of the game know as Levi Chronicles! Im pretty new to Steam and all the bells and whistles, But ill get there.

Levi Chronicles is currently being Solo Dev by me and will maybe have some help in the future! 

To give you a summary of what is happening. Levi is a Explorer/Historian. When Levi was young Levi lost his parents. This very badly affected him when hew grew up. after a few Years Levi discovered his dads old work. 

Levi's dad was trying to find the missing link of the gods. Now Levi has set out to finish his dads work so his death wasnt in vane. 

Now Levi has gone on a Expidition to the Ice Mountains and hasnt returned. There expedition didnt report back in time. 

This is where you come in. You as the player and your friends will need to try and locate Levi before the weather gets too cold. You will be tested. You will be Hurt. You will be Strong! This will be good!

THANK YOU for reading and be ready for a advanture!

Can you find Levi?
